zh: 儲蓄保險／IRR 領取規劃新增三種領取方式：保留原本固定金額，並新增「分段百分比」與「反推最大領取」。分段模式可直接輸入例如「4到10年拿4%，11到20年拿5%，21到30年拿6%，31到40年拿7%，41年後拿8%」，亦支援 `4-10:4%; 11-20:5%; 41+:8%` 等簡寫。
分段百分比可選擇按「原始總保費本金」或「當年帳戶／保單價值」計算，避免百分比口徑不清；逐年現金流、累計領取、期末保單價值與全周期 IRR 會按同一套規則重新計算。
新增 IRR 反推領取策略。使用者輸入目標／假設年化回報、開始領取年度、測算終止年度、每隔幾年加碼、每次加多少、最高領取率及期末本金底線後，系統以數值搜尋找出「在守住本金底線前提下，起始領取率盡量高」的方案。
反推結果同時提供 100% 理想情景（明確標示非保證）、90% 較差情景與 80% 壓力情景；三個情景會分別顯示可持續起始領取率、完整分段領取路徑、累計領取、期末本金及實際現金流 IRR，避免把演示回報誤當成保證收益。
智能資產組合與退休組合補齊收益來源拆解。派息／利息不再只隱含在總年化內，而會分開顯示現金利息、債券票息／分派、股票／ETF 派息，以及保單價值、債券淨值、股票／ETF 淨值變動；各來源加總會與總投資收益對得上，避免重複計算。
完整 Flutter 回歸擴充至 123 項並全部通過；Web Release 構建成功，分段領取自然語句解析、按本金／按帳戶價值計算及 100%／90%／80% 反推壓力情景均有專項測試。
en: Savings-insurance / IRR payout planning now supports three withdrawal methods: the existing fixed-amount mode plus tiered-percentage withdrawals and reverse-optimized withdrawals. Tiered rules accept natural language such as `years 4-10: 4%, 11-20: 5%, 21-30: 6%, 31-40: 7%, 41+: 8%` as well as compact schedule syntax.

Tiered percentages can be based on either original gross premium or current policy/account value, removing ambiguity around what the withdrawal percentage applies to. Yearly cash flow, cumulative withdrawals, ending policy value and full-period IRR are recalculated on the same basis.

Added reverse withdrawal optimization. Given an assumed/target annual return, withdrawal start year, planning horizon, step interval, step increase, maximum withdrawal rate and ending-principal floor, the app numerically searches for the highest sustainable starting withdrawal rate that still preserves the selected principal floor.

Optimization returns three scenarios side by side: ideal 100% realization (explicitly marked non-guaranteed), lower 90% realization and 80% stress realization. Each scenario shows the sustainable starting rate, full stepped withdrawal path, cumulative withdrawals, ending principal and realized cash-flow IRR.

Smart portfolio and retirement portfolio results now break total return into actual sources instead of hiding income inside one blended annual rate: cash interest, bond coupon/distribution, stock/ETF dividends, plus insurance-value, bond-NAV and stock/ETF-NAV changes. Source totals reconcile to total projected investment profit without double-counting.

The full Flutter regression suite now contains 123 passing tests; the Web release build succeeds, including dedicated coverage for natural-language tiered schedules, principal-vs-balance withdrawal bases and 100%/90%/80% optimization stress scenarios.
